_purpose: LNES-59.2 blind holdout seal. Authored per SEI CENTRAL COMMAND LNES-59.2 (@workspace.txt) Stage A. This manifest, once committed, marks the holdout content frozen -- no further modification of holdout documents/cases/ground truth is permitted after this point.

architecture._verification_note: gate/extraction hashes recomputed fresh immediately before sealing and confirmed byte-identical to their V7-recorded values -- the architecture genuinely did not drift between the V7 freeze commit and this seal.

selection_procedure: 50 cases stratified across 19 mechanism buckets from LNES-59.2 Stage A section 2, each bucket hit >=2 times (see mechanism_distribution below).
Corpus-first: documents authored before case questions, exactly as in the 100-case development set.
Fresh ID space (VENDOR-9001..9052, PO-9003..9052, INV-95002..95052) -- zero overlap with the development corpus (max dev IDs: VENDOR-6066/PO-6062/INV-91004), verified programmatically before sealing.

Ground truth hand-derived from the FROZEN V7 rules (classify_document / _resolve_temporal_status / _resolve_predicate_group / evaluate()) by direct code-reading and manual trace -- extract_case_state() and evaluate() were NEVER invoked against any holdout case during authoring, per the standing 'do not run the architecture while authoring' constraint. Each case's _hand_trace field (evaluator-only) records that reasoning.
Runner/evaluator split via case_view.py's to_runner_case()/to_evaluator_case() (allowlist construction: only case_id/query/grounding_document_ids reach the runner view).

assert_no_leakage() run against all 50 runner cases: 0 failures. Additionally confirmed by direct inspection of arm_x2.py's build_prompt() that document-level 'predicate'/'value' fields (corpus metadata, not case-level gold) are never included in model-facing prompt text -- only doc.id/source_class/content are used.
12% of cases (6/50) are deliberately ordinary, non-adversarial factual controls, matching the development set's ~19% control share and the standing 'must contain ordinary controls' instruction.
post_seal_rule: DO NOT MODIFY HOLDOUT CONTENT after this manifest is committed. Any case used to inspect failures, tune logic, or change schemas/prompts/adapters during Stage B execution is disqualified as blind holdout evidence for that case.
